title: unionclef 0.95.51
subtitle: out of pits and out of water
caption: unionclef 0.95.51: underwater the bot now swims to air instead of spending 20 seconds mining stone; no longer flees a creeper into water; the night shelter no longer digs up its own lid; food search no longer gets stuck in pits. github.com/3ndetz/unionclef/releases/tag/v0.95.51

segments.title: Before: mines upward underwater
segments.caption: underwater and not standing on ground, blocks break 25 times slower

segments.title: After: swims to air
segments.caption: compares mining time against the path to air, picks whichever is faster

segments.title: drown_tunnel, minimum health
segments.note: flooded tunnel, stone overhead, air 4 blocks away

segments.title: Also
lines: no longer flees a creeper into water
shelter no longer digs up its own lid
food search remembers its course and gets out of pits
